source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (read 2026-11-05; neon/v3.2 added 2026-11-20; google/gemini-4-hydrogen added from GET 2026-11-20); USD = listed per-token price × 1e6
unit: USD per million tokens; OpenRouter list prices. Batch rows are the catalog :batch endpoints (typically ~½ sync). Cache rates as published; omit cacheWrite when the catalog has none (implicit free write).
caching: OpenRouter maps provider caches into usage.prompt_tokens_details.{cached_tokens,cache_write_tokens}. System prefix is stable; item text last. Anthropic/Qwen need explicit cache_control (OpenRouterProvider sends it when OPENROUTER/ANTHROPIC_PROMPT_CACHE ≠ off). OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek often cache implicitly above provider minima (e.g. OpenAI ≥1024, Gemini Flash often ≥4096).
batch: Async Batch API POST /api/v1/batches; typically ~50% of sync token price. Use for offline eval only. Batch retains data ≤30 days and cannot use ZDR. Sync generate rejects :batch model ids.
